parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, border screening rule, facility ban, or documented visitor-facing targeting. Legal same-sex conduct and a broad progressive civic climate (large pride, trans march, equality jurisprudence) support low state severity if outed. The 2008 surgery requirement and domestic protections are resident-facing climate signals, not visitor safeguards. Main friction is facilities: reported restroom/changing-room discrimination and poor standards for many all-gender toilets, plus rising anti-gender political discourse. These are social/institutional frictions rather than universal exclusion or organised targeting. Unknowns remain on airport/document mismatch, detention placement, and emergency-care treatment; absence of violence data is not safety. Overall: reduced risk, tempered by documented everyday facility friction and incomplete visitor-facing remedies.
